# Ankush Yadav

> AI and software development studio in India, run by Ankush Yadav, an AI product developer with 2+ years of experience. Turns ideas into digital products: websites, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, e-commerce, AI agents, AI automation, custom software, business platforms and API integrations, from idea to launch and handover. Five products delivered to clients, each with an explorable mockup on this site (mockups run on sample data only).

## What he builds
- Android apps: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, AGSL shaders, accessibility and foreground services, Capacitor, React Native / Expo.
- Web and servers: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, Hono, Express, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, SQLite with vector search, Firebase.
- AI products: voice assistants, LLM orchestration with Claude and Gemini, on-device models, long-term memory.

## Products (status as shown on the site)
- Strikedeck (delivered to client; trades live for the client behind a safety gate; not investment advice; no performance claims): options trading desk for Indian markets. Live broker ticks, engine consensus, safety gate, paper-to-live promotion. React, Express 5, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, Flutter clients. 1,871 source files, 763 test files.
- Mikazuki (delivered to client): a voice operating system for one person on Android. Wake word, cloud and on-device brains, vector memory, on-phone execution. Kotlin, Compose, Bun, Hono, sqlite-vec.
- Sri Hari Docs (delivered to client): truck paperwork for an agri-trading company. Photograph, extract, match the right truck, complete paper trail. React, Capacitor, Firebase. Hindi and English.
- ShopConnect (delivered to client): offline-first Android retail app with four roles: customer, shop, rider and admin. Expo 58, React Native, TypeScript.
- Business toolkit (delivered to client; name withheld): zero-budget programme with research, two-checker fact-checking, a repository validator with 14 tests, and an owner approval gate before any build phase.

## Services
- AI assistants and automation: voice, chat and agent workflows on Claude or Gemini, with approval gates.
- Document processing: photograph, extract fields with confidence, match to the right record, file.
- Android and web apps: from first sketch to an installable release; offline-first where needed.

## How a project runs
1. Brief: the client says what to build, who it is for and when. Reply within a day.
2. Scope: a written scope and a fixed quote before work starts.
3. Build: milestones, each a build the client can open and try.
4. Review: the client tests and asks for changes; nothing is released without approval.
5. Handover: the release, source code and handover notes go to the client.
Ways to work: discovery sprint, fixed-scope build, ongoing engineering.
